approval_evidence.quote: Approval Date(s) and History, Letters, Labels, Reviews for NDA 205382 ... 04/30/2014 ORIG-1 Approval Type 5 - New Formulation or New Manufacturer; INCRUSE ELLIPTA

series_start_reason: The Q1 2015 release (6-K 2015-05-06) is the first GSK results release that prints an Incruse Ellipta sales row; the Q4 2014 release (6-K 2015-02-04) and Q3 2014 release (6-K 2014-10-22) print none.
series_end_reason: From the Q1 2024 release (6-K 2024-05-01) GSK's respiratory table lists Anoro, Flixotide/Flovent, Relvar/Breo, Seretide/Advair, Trelegy, Ventolin and 'Other Respiratory' only; Incruse Ellipta is no longer a separate row (folded into Other Respiratory). The Q4 2023 release (6-K 2024-01-31) is the last that prints it.
notes: Worldwide GSK turnover for Incruse Ellipta in GBP millions. 2015Q1-2015Q4 come from the 'Sales from New Pharmaceutical and Vaccine products' table (Q1 2015 shows one period, Q2/Q3 the quarter then year-to-date, Q4 the full year then the quarter); from 2016Q1 the product is a row of the regional 'Pharmaceuticals turnover' table (Total column used). FDA approval 2014-04-30; Q1 2014-Q4 2014 releases print no Incruse sales row (checked 6-K 2014-10-22 and 2015-02-04), and no cited document dates a launch quarter, so launch_quarter is null. The first-approval FDA record lists the Type 5 (new formulation) approval; umeclidinium monotherapy was first approved as Incruse.
search_log: fetched data.sec.gov submissions CIK0001131399 (GSK plc) recent + history pages; selected 6-K / 6-K/A filings whose primaryDocDescription is a quarterly/half-year/final results announcement (plus 2010-2012 6-Ks matching RESULT/TURNOVER/FORM 6-K/QUARTER/HALF); downloaded each and converted tables to text

per release: product row located by exact row label in the 'Pharmaceuticals turnover' regional table (Total column = worldwide) or, where the product is absent from it, in the 'Sales from New Pharmaceutical and Vaccine products' table; Q1 taken from the Q1 release, Q2/Q3 from the 3-month column of the Q2/Q3 release, Q4 from the 3-month column of the Q4/full-year release (the same release prints the full-year row)
cross-check: Q1+Q2+Q3+Q4 equals the full-year row printed in the Q4 release for every complete year, and Q1+Q2 / +Q3 equal the printed six-/nine-month rows
FDA approval: fetched the Drugs@FDA overview page for the NDA
2024-2026 releases searched (6-K 2024-05-01, 2024-07-31, 2024-10-30, 2025-02-05 and later): no 'Incruse' row; respiratory table shows 'Other Respiratory' instead
Q1 2015 release is first with an Incruse row; pre-2015 releases (2014-10-22, 2015-02-04) contain no row
